reviews.text: Wonderful couple owns this and they truly care about their clients' pets. Super high-quality products.
Absolutely excellent, healthy, and cost friendly selection of everything you could need for your dog and cat.

Jason was so informative and knowledgeable about the product within the store. He was also extremely helpful and patient while taking his time to explain each product in depth. I highly recommend this local business and I will be returning!

We stumbled upon this place today; accidentally came in right before they closed. They were so friendly! They told us not to rush at all, and they showed us so many great products. This will be our go to place now!
The amount of attitude and disrespect Diana has is uncalled for. The judgement in the eyes anytime I said anything made me feel very unwelcome and like a hostage. NEVER GOING THERE AGAIN!

Genuinely the best pet store experience I’ve ever had! Can’t say enough good things. The expertise is unmatched & the helpfulness to truly explain what your pet is needing and consuming to keep them healthy is so appreciated!!
Highly Recommend,  Quality, Knowledgeable, Fantastic Experience, Great Customer Service, Special Orders. Tutu luvs Quality ▶️ Feline Natural brand in packet, cans, freeze dried.

Wow! I’ve never had such a great and educational experience at a pet store. I came in looking for food samples for my picky dog and the owner walked me through their products and helped me troubleshoot his digestive issues. The other employee was a dry food brand rep who gave me lots of samples. My picky dog LIKED EVERY SAMPLE! This has never happened before. I wish every local store was this helpful. I am switching his food and although I can buy it online I will make it a point to come and buy it in person to support this great local business.

Places like these is what makes me want to shop at local stores instead of online. I came in because they carry an incredible jerky treat that my dog and I discovered in Colorado recently.. the owner was incredibly knowledgeable and very enthusiastic about dog nutrition and really wanted to know about what else I may need because I’ve been thinking about switching dog food. I left with treats toppers, and a bunch of samples of food to try.
I will definitely be back.

Diana is a sweetheart. You can tell she runs this store with love and pride. She's a very caring and knowledgeable person when it comes to food options and ingredients. This will definitely be our store for our dogs going forward. We love that we can have quality food for our fur babies and support a small business.
Owners are so nice and helpful. Great options for a small store. Personalized service. They always remember my dog's name! Highly recommend supporting this small business

Diana and Tony go above and beyond for me and my kitty. This is a true small business, founded on great values and customer service. I’m a new cat mom, and Diana made me feel so welcomed and educated. I wish the absolute best for them and intend to be a life long customer. Extra thank you to Diana :)
Diana, the owner, was so kind and helpful on the phone. We were looking for specific food options for our pup and she was a wealth of info. Looking forward to becoming a customer of theirs.

Diana and Tony truly love animals and are very knowledgeable in this business.
Diana can help you choose the right food for your pet, whether you have a cat or a dog, and she can share a lot of important and interesting information about dog and cat nutrition.
Their products are more holistic, so this is a great place to improve your pet’s diet and overall nutrition.
We found them when I did a search to buy fresh dog food. We love this place. We just won a great treat basket and toys for our first babies. Highly recommend this place for your fur babies 😊 …

Wonderful family-owned store that supplies natural and healthy food supplies! I shop here for all my puppies essentials and the owners are incredibly helpful and full of information. Love shopping here!

As someone who loves to support small family owned/operated businesses, Fetch is outstanding. Diana and Tony are incredibly knowledgeable about every product they carry and they strive to carry products that your pet will love. What I loved was that many of the products they carried were also from family owned companies too. Definitely worth checking them out!

We’re visiting from out of state & wanted 2 check out there dog stuff . Very nice store , with reasonable prices & very friendly service . We will definitely be coming back here next time we visit . If ur looking 4 a reasonable priced store 4 ur dog supplies with a very friendly gentleman working here I’d encourage u 2 stop here .They even have rabbit fur 4 ur furry friends  . U won’t be disappointed we wasn’t. Thanks 4 ur helpful friendly service .

I love love love this place.  Diana was very knowledgeable and it's a bonus that I knew the store from my previous job working in the industry.  I definitely will be coming back to get my furry kids food.  They have got a customer for life! Thank you Diana!

★★★★★
Best local pet store ever!

We just moved to the area and this little shop has become our instant favorite. The staff is super friendly and knowledgeable they always give great, personalized advice without pushing sales.

Great selection of high-quality food, treats, toys, and accessories at fair prices. The store is clean, welcoming, and full of that genuine small-business charm.

Highly recommend to any pet parents in the neighborhood. 🐾
Very good people with amazing pet food varieties! I definitely recommend this place!

I started coming to Fetch to support the new owners, Diana and Tony! They are both so knowledgeable and go above and beyond when it comes to pet food ingredients and lifelong health. Diana has an incredible background in holistic wellness and seriously knows every ingredient every supplement every food benefit like the back of her hand she helped me understand what my pet actually needed instead of guessing or buying whatever I thought “might help”. The store is spotless, beautifully organized, and full of high-quality carefully curated brands you won’t find on chewy or online retailers. Tony is also the nicest human… even timid dogs seem to love him. You can tell both owners generally care about every pet that walks through the door. Local businesses like this are rare and I’m so grateful for this part of our community.

Hands down the best pet food store in Phoenix!

I have been coming to Fetch for the last two years and they are the most friendly and amazing individuals. I have four dogs, two of which are Frenchies. As many people may know Frenchies often have a lot of allergies and health problems. I was going through a bout where my female Frenchie didn’t like her food anymore and was getting really bad allergies with everything she ate. I saw fetch on social media and loved everything they were about. Safer foods and treats, better for your dogs health, no rawhide, small business, and they celebrate with the community and ALWAYS give the samples they receive to customers. I will continue to support fetch and buy my babies food and treats from them. Thank you fetch for everything❤️ also there’s a cute picture of Winnie with scout (store dog).

With the name and ownership change, Fetch is still a great place to get pet food, treats, and toys. Diana and Tony are knowledgeable and helpful. It's especially fun on Saturday as people bring their pets. If you're seeking high quality, specialized food or treats for your pet(s), this is the place. Plus, they can quickly special order items for you (which they do for me quite often). I highly recommend Fetch. Our pets deserve it!
We are grateful for the genuinely gracious treatment we get when we come to Fetch to get food for our cats. A happy experience all around. Thanks, Fetch!
Family owned and run, so much personal care, patience, and attention to detail. We love Fetch!
